config_dir.description: Directory where Brewtarget stores configuration files.

data_dir.description: Directory where Brewtarget stores application data such as default ingredient databases.

lang.description: Language and locale for the interface (e.g., 'en_US', 'sv_SE').

database_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server used for recipe and ingredient storage.

database_port.description: Port number of the PostgreSQL server.

database_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database used by Brewtarget.

database_user.description: Username for authenticating to the PostgreSQL database.

database_pass.description: Password for authenticating to the PostgreSQL database (leave empty to use peer or other auth method).

log_file.description: Path (relative or absolute) to the log file.

font_scale.description: Font scaling factor (1.0 = 100%). Used for UI scaling on high-DPI displays.

units.description: Unit system: 'metric', 'imperial'. Controls default display units for volumes, masses, temperatures.

default_recipe_dir.description: Default directory where user-created recipes are saved.

backup_enabled.description: Enable automatic backup of the recipe database.

backup_interval_days.description: Number of days between automatic backups.

backup_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain backups before deletion.

backups.description: Additional directories where backups should be stored (e.g., for redundancy or offsite backup).

style_database_path.description: Absolute or relative path to a custom style database file (e.g., 'styles.xml').

ingredient_database_path.description: Absolute or relative path to a custom ingredient database file (e.g., 'ingredients.xml').
